title: Microcystin-LR detection and removal using MOF-based functional materials
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00183H, Tutorial Review
Hong-Yu Chu, Ze-Ming Huang, Ge Shen, Yuliang Dong, Chong-Chen Wang
The design principles and the pivotal roles of MOFs in microcystin-LR detection and removal (adsorption and catalytic degradation) were summarized.
